title: Composition with a final transition edge in a mapping simplex
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ and simplicial mapping sets of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. Let $n>0$ and let $A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_n$ be any chain of small simplicial sets. Define $M$ by $M_r=\coprod_{\alpha:[r]\to[n]}(A_{\alpha(r)})_r$, with operators $(\alpha,a)\mapsto(\alpha\theta,t_{\alpha(r),\alpha\theta(s)}\theta^*a)$ for $\theta:[s]\to[r]$, where $t_{j,i}:A_j\to A_i$ is the chain composite. For a vertex $y\in A_n$, put $y'=t_{n,n-1}(y)$ in the fiber over $n-1$, and let $e:y'\to y$ be the edge of $M$ represented by $n-1\leq n$ and $s_0y\in(A_n)_1$. For every vertex $x$ of $M$ over an index less than $n$, enriched composition with the vertex $[e]\in\mathfrak C[M](y',y)_0$ is a weak homotopy equivalence
$$\mathfrak C[M](x,y')\xrightarrow{[e]\circ-}\mathfrak C[M](x,y).$$
No quasicategory or fibration hypothesis on any $A_i$ or on $M$ is imposed.
